speaker: narr
text: She planted her cane on the helipad and vaulted onto the railing, just to feel the wind.

speaker: narr
text: His wheels were still crackling with sparks. He honked twice. For luck.

speaker: narr
text: The King straightened his crown on the helipad. "This roof is under the crown's protection."

speaker: narr
text: Michelle fixed her tiara and took one last look at the sunset.

speaker: narr
text: Oyakata threw a handful of salt over the helipad to clean the ring.

speaker: narr
text: Then he sat down. The whole roof shook. SUDS-9 never stood a chance.

speaker: narr
text: Kyoto sent him a new mawashi, in Pearl Sail blue.

speaker: narr
text: Barnacle picked up what was left of SUDS-9 like a crate on a pallet.

speaker: narr
text: He sold the scrap to the Salt Building. Twice.

speaker: narr
text: The bandits still sing a song about it. It is not a good song.

speaker: narr
text: Jalapeño Jack tipped his hat to the empty gondola.

speaker: narr
text: He left one red pepper on the helipad, so they would know who did it.

speaker: narr
text: Nobody on the Pearl Sail has dared to eat it.

speaker: narr
text: Rook blew the smoke off his laser and looked out over Meru.

speaker: narr
text: "Good view," he said. "Good place for a hideout."

speaker: narr
text: The Pearl Sail changed every lock on the building that night.

speaker: narr
text: Lox stood over the gondola rails, gloves up, breathing hard.

speaker: narr
text: Luxor will hear about this. Every word.

speaker: narr
text: He hung SUDS-9's squeegee on the wall of his throne room. It is still there.

speaker: narr
text: The Iron Warden stomped once on the helipad. Every window in the Pearl Sail rattled.

speaker: narr
text: It scanned the horizon for the next challenger. None came.

speaker: narr
text: The Meru Arena put it back on guard duty. It now waves at the crowd.

speaker: narr
text: Maker Prime lifted SUDS-9 in its claw and carried it home to the factory.

speaker: narr
text: Three days later a new window cleaner rolled out. It was very polite.

speaker: narr
text: The Pearl Sail has never been cleaner. Or more nervous.

speaker: narr
text: SUDS-9 cleaned the helipad until it shone like a mirror.

speaker: narr
text: Then he cleaned the gondola. Then the moon, as far as his pole would reach.

speaker: narr
text: The Pearl Sail gave him a raise: one extra bucket.

speaker: narr
text: Slagback stood on the helipad, glowing in the dark like a sunset that never ended.

speaker: narr
text: Where it walked, the roof tiles turned to glass.

speaker: narr
text: Meru calls the Pearl Sail the Lava Tower now. Nobody argues.

speaker: narr
text: The Crystal Warden stood on the helipad and the moonlight broke into a thousand colours across Meru.

speaker: narr
text: Every window on the Pearl Sail hummed one clear note.

speaker: narr
text: The caves under Luxor glow a little brighter now. It is waiting for the next challenger.
